end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane.
Used signs to decide left/right movement and identified quadrant II for (−3, 2).
Harsh explained that positive x-values move right and negative x-values move left.
The mix-up between (3, 2) and (2, 3) remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised plotting points by moving horizontally first and then vertically, using the signs to choose direction. Harsh correctly described positive movement to the right, negative movement to the left, and identified quadrant II for (−3, 2). They continued to treat (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point, and this was not corrected in the lesson. At home, draw a grid and ask Harsh to plot both points separately, saying the x-move and y-move aloud each time.
